system.description:
Cavalry shields, worn on horseback normally, protect against melee and unarmed attacks, as well as ranged and thrown weapons. They only count against attacks coming from the side of the shoulder over which they are slung (typically the left). If used dismounted, Bonus Traits drop to 2 and Negative Traits include Clumsy x2.

Negative Traits: Clumsy (x2 if dismounted), Heavy

Availability: Resources x3, Rare
system.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages), Rules, Systems and Drama
